description: Start a new Plan for a goal the merchant has agreed and no existing Plan covers, with a title, areas, milestones and an optional brief. Schedules and recurring work are approved in Fudge.

areas.description: Areas the Plan serves; empty for store-wide work.

brief.description: Markdown brief: goal, audience, decisions and constraints. Saved as brief.md in the Plan.

note.description: One merchant-facing line on the intended outcome.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

title.description: Short outcome-focused title, e.g. “Rank for trail running shoes”.

name: create_plan
title: Create Plan
